description: This Java source file defines the 'ScopedDirectoryAccessFragment' class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying and managing scoped directory access within an app. It handles UI elements for directory navigation, permissions handling, and displaying directory entries, primarily through interaction with the Android Storage Access Framework and content providers.

classes.name: ScopedDirectoryAccessFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays directory contents and handles directory access via Storage Access Framework, allowing users to navigate and select directories, and displays directory entries.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes context references and system services when fragment attaches to activity.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from directory access intents, requesting persistable URI permissions and updating directory entries.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets click listeners for directory access buttons, and prepares recycler view and spinner.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current directory and entries state for configuration changes.

methods.name: updateDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Queries and displays current directory contents given a URI.

methods.name: getDirectoryName
methods.description: Maps UI selected names to actual directory environment constants.
